vocab_cards.example_en: I eat an apple after lunch.
The chair is near the window.
Their house has a small garden.
We listen to music at home.
Her school is close to our house.
We walk to the bus stop.
The train will arrive at noon.
Choose a seat by the door.
The town holds a spring festival.
I bought a gift for my sister.
The kitchen is bright and warm.
It is normal to feel nervous.
We ordered two bowls of noodles.
This café is popular with students.
I will return the book tomorrow.
Keep your ticket in a safe place.
She achieved her weekly study goal.
A balance between work and rest matters.
Speaking in public is a challenge for him.
The result depends on careful planning.
We should protect the local environment.
The app has a useful search feature.
Generally, buses are cheaper than taxis.
Reading before bed is a good habit.
He keeps a journal of new words.
We bought fruit from a local shop.
Can you manage your time better?
I noticed a mistake in the report.
The course offers an opportunity to practise.
I recommend this podcast to beginners.
Teams must adapt to changing needs.
Regular feedback has a clear benefit.
The chart demonstrates a steady rise.
A clear plan makes the process efficient.
Remote work can offer flexible hours.
You need to justify your opinion.
The outcome was better than expected.
Try to see the issue from another perspective.
Their strategy focused on customer needs.
The skill transfers to other tasks.
She is willing to try again.
Her argument is coherent and focused.
The team derived insight from the survey.
The evidence does not justify that claim.
Likewise, small teams need clear goals.
We modified the plan after testing.
The notion of success varies widely.
Savings may offset the initial cost.
We should address the underlying cause.
The comparison is valid only in context.
The experiment may yield useful data.
A simple definition can be elusive.
The author juxtaposes fact and opinion.

pronunciation_items.title: /iː/
pronunciation_items.tip: Keep the lips relaxed and the tongue high.

pronunciation_items.title: /ɪ/
pronunciation_items.tip: Use a shorter, looser vowel than /iː/.

pronunciation_items.title: /æ/
pronunciation_items.tip: Open the jaw and keep the front of the tongue low.

pronunciation_items.title: /θ/
pronunciation_items.tip: Place the tongue lightly between the teeth and release air.

pronunciation_items.title: sheep–ship
pronunciation_items.script: I saw a sheep by the ship.

pronunciation_items.title: rice–lice
pronunciation_items.script: Rice and lice are different words.

pronunciation_items.title: fan–van
pronunciation_items.script: The fan is beside the van.

pronunciation_items.title: seat–sheet
pronunciation_items.script: Take a seat near the sheet.

pronunciation_items.title: A1 greeting
pronunciation_items.script: Hello, I am Mai. I study English every evening.
pronunciation_items.tip: Aim for a calm, even rhythm.

pronunciation_items.title: A2 plan
pronunciation_items.script: I am going to meet my friend after work.

pronunciation_items.title: B1 opinion
pronunciation_items.script: In my view, a short daily habit is easier to maintain.
pronunciation_items.tip: Stress view, daily, easier and maintain.

pronunciation_items.title: B2 comparison
pronunciation_items.script: Although the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable.
pronunciation_items.tip: Use contrastive stress on cheaper and reliable.

pronunciation_items.title: C1 analysis
pronunciation_items.script: The evidence suggests a pattern, but it does not establish a cause.

pronunciation_items.title: C2 nuance
pronunciation_items.script: The proposal is promising, albeit dependent on several assumptions.

passages.title: My New Neighbour
passages.body: Mai has a new neighbour named Ben. Ben has a small dog and walks it every morning. On Saturday, Mai and Ben drink tea in the garden.

passages.title: A Change of Plan
passages.body: The museum is closed this afternoon, so Linh and her cousin will visit the riverside market instead. They will meet at the bus stop at two thirty.

passages.title: The Shared Garden
passages.body: Residents turned an empty corner into a shared garden. They meet twice a month, grow vegetables and give extra food to neighbours.

passages.title: Choosing a Workshop
passages.body: The team chose the longer workshop because it included practice, individual feedback and a follow-up session.

passages.title: Office Visitor
passages.body: Good morning. The lift to the fifth floor is being repaired, so please use the stairs near reception. Your meeting room has not changed.
passages.transcript: Good morning. The lift to the fifth floor is being repaired, so please use the stairs near reception. Your meeting room has not changed.

passages.title: Station Announcement
passages.body: The 8:15 train to Da Nang will leave from platform four today. Passengers requiring assistance should speak to a member of staff.
passages.transcript: The 8:15 train to Da Nang will leave from platform four today. Passengers requiring assistance should speak to a member of staff.

passages.title: Team Update Email
passages.body: Thank you for joining yesterday’s product meeting. Please send your comments on the draft by Thursday so we can prepare the final version on Friday.

passages.title: Community Centre Notice
passages.body: The community centre will extend its evening opening hours during October. The study room will remain available until 9 p.m., while the sports hall will close at 8 p.m.

passages.title: Library Orientation
passages.body: The new library workshop begins at 10:30 in Room B12. Students should bring their campus card. The session includes a tour and a short database demonstration.
passages.transcript: The new library workshop begins at 10:30 in Room B12. Students should bring their campus card. The session includes a tour and a short database demonstration.

passages.title: Urban Trees
passages.body: Trees in cities can lower local temperatures and reduce noise. Their benefits depend on species, location and long-term maintenance, not simply on the number planted.
